title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
summary: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.

title: Solana Treasury Firm DeFi Development Keeps Buying SOL as CHAD Preferred Stock Hits Record
summary: The Nasdaq-listed company now holds about 2.59 million SOL, but its weekly purchases keep shrinking.

title: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
summary: Evernorth's XRPN shares began trading Monday after its SPAC merger closed, but 80% of SPAC investors cashed out first and its XRP stash is worth roughly 40% less than at signing.

title: Bitcoin Spooked? Crypto Fear and Greed Index Drops to Pre-Rally August Lows
summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index has dropped to 56 from an August peak of 82, as oil, bond yields, and ETF outflows hit Bitcoin in October.

title: Ledger Says All Confirmed Cases in Suspected $87M Drain Tied to Reseller CryptoBilis
summary: The wallet manufacturer said its own systems and direct sales are unaffected, and that the reseller has stopped selling hardware wallets.

title: XRP Ledger’s Payment Engine Had a Counterfeiting Bug Hiding Since 2015
summary: An integer overflow in the payment engine, dormant since 2015, could have let an attacker mint spendable XRP beyond the token’s total supply.

title: Bitmine Adds $32M in Ethereum as Tom Lee Says Firm Is Nearly 'Done Stacking'
summary: The Ethereum treasury firm now holds 6.03 million ETH, 4.9% of supply, as Lee predicts the biggest crypto bull market yet.

title: Strategy Scoops Up $21.5M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $192M in STRC
summary: The purchase lifts Strategy's holdings to 848,250 BTC and follows a $176 million repurchase of STRC preferred stock the week before.

title: Bitcoin Ranges Near $83K as Traders Look to US Inflation Data
summary: October rate-hike odds have slumped, but analysts say Treasury yields at two-decade highs are still keeping a lid on risk appetite.

title: UK Freezes $12M London Penthouse of Alleged Prince Group Finance Chief
summary: Thet Li is accused of running the finances of a scam empire tied to $14 billion in Bitcoin the U.S. has moved to seize.

title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs All in the Red for October
summary: Bitcoin ETFs have seen $386.3 million in net outflows through the first seven trading days of October, while Ethereum funds have now posted nine straight days of losses.

title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
summary: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the “swap” definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gambling—sharpening the agency’s claim to exclusive jurisdiction.

title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
summary: The Bermuda-based insurer, which runs entirely on Bitcoin, drew the funding from existing backers led by Bain Capital Crypto after a record year driven by demand from wealthy families in Asia, Europe and the Middle East.

title: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
summary: A National Assembly committee adopted amendments taxing stablecoin swaps and crypto exits by wealthy holders, then rejected the 2027 budget's revenue section.

title: Blockchain.com Seeks Approval for US Prediction Markets and Crypto Derivatives
summary: The crypto platform filed for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses, which would let it run its own regulated event-contract venue instead of relying on overseas partners.

title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Rough Week, But Traders Are Pricing In More Downside
summary: Bitcoin bounced after dipping to around $80,000. Traders are placing increasingly high odds BTC slips further before October is over.

title: Ethereum L2 Starknet Jumps 20% After Saying It Wants to Become an L1
summary: Starknet is "actively considering" becoming its own blockchain, a move it says would make it the first fully quantum-resistant network by 2027.

title: DWF Labs Subsidiaries Sue BitGo for $141 Million Over Early Token Sales
summary: The DWF Labs-linked firms allege in London’s High Court that BitGo sold discounted Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens roughly two months before their lock-up expired, cratering the value of their remaining holdings.

title: Ledger Probes Potential Theft of $87M in User Funds Tied to Crypto Wallet Reseller
summary: Ledger asked reseller CryptoBilis to pause sales and urged recent buyers not to set up their devices, as an onchain investigator tracked more than $86 million in suspected thefts.

title: Bitcoin Bleeds in Uptober—How Low Can It Go? Experts Weigh In
summary: Experts highlight several support levels, from $83,000 down to $72,000, that Bitcoin may need to test in a bearish start to Uptober.
